name: find_health_facilities
description: Nearest health facilities to a place (primary care practices, hospitals and other institutions) with address and distance, from HZZO open data. Does not give medical advice.

location.description: Place name in nominative case, e.g. 'Vinkovci'. After an ambiguous place send the option the user chose as the answer named it, e.g. 'Luka u gradu Vrbovec'.

facility_type.description: Maps to HZZO categories: family_medicine = opća/obiteljska medicina, pediatrics = pedijatrija, gynecology = ginekologija, dentistry = dentalna zdravstvena zaštita, hospital = opće i kliničke bolnice; any = all of these. Locations are known to settlement level only. Default: any.

limit.description: How many facilities to return (1-5). Use 3 unless the user asks for more.
